basic_details.job_title: NHSRC Consultant - Lead Front End Developer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC), under the National Health Mission (NHM), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, has invited online applications for 1 Consultant - Lead Front End Developer (Angular) position on a short-term contract of 11 months based in New Delhi. Eligible candidates meeting the required qualifications and experience can submit their applications online through the official website http://nhsrcindia.org by 11th November 2026.

how_to_apply: Visit the official NHSRC website at http://nhsrcindia.org.
Fill out the online application correctly which is available on the NHSRC website.
Applications will be accepted in the prescribed online application format only.
Submit the application before the last date of receiving applications which is 11th November 2026.
important_instructions: The Position requires a strong moral and ethical code of conduct with essence of integrity, confidentiality while undertaking the responsibility. Preference will be given to candidates residing within Delhi/NCR region. Willingness to travel on need basis from New Delhi work location.

content_sections.heading: About NHSRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: National Health Systems Resource Centre (NHSRC) is a technical support institution under the National Health Mission (NHM), Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, working closely with the MoHFW and States for Health Systems strengthening and supporting implementation of other interventions under the NHM. Work at the NHSRC is organised around eight divisions, namely– Community Processes & Comprehensive Primary Care, Healthcare Financing, Healthcare Technology, Human Resources for Health, Information Technology, Knowledge Management Division, Public Health Administration and Quality & Patient Safety.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification offers a single position across the organisation. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the prescribed essential qualifications, experience, and age limits to be considered for the position. Desirable: Experience working on Government IT Projects at the National level.

rows.essential_qualification_experience: B.E./B.Tech./MCA/M.E./M.Tech. from a recognized university or institution, with experience – 10 years or more.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consultancy is a short-term position for 11 months. The remuneration range is between Rs. 1,25,000/- to Rs. 1,50,000/- per month. *Fee offered within the band will be commensurate with qualification and experience.

content_sections.heading: NHSRC Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will report to the Principal Team Lead- Technical NHSRC and will be responsible for the following roles & responsibilities: Develop responsive web and PWA applications for public health program users. Build reusable Angular components and front-end modules. Create user-friendly interfaces for care delivery, program operations, and reporting workflows. Integrate front-end applications with backend APIs. Collaborate with product, design, backend, QA, and implementation teams.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHSRC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official NHSRC website at http://nhsrcindia.org . Fill out the online application correctly which is available on the NHSRC website. Applications will be accepted in the prescribed online application format only. Submit the application before the last date of receiving applications which is 11th November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The candidates may be subjected to written tests. The selected candidate will be required to join within 7 days.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The Position requires a strong moral and ethical code of conduct with essence of integrity, confidentiality while undertaking the responsibility. Preference will be given to candidates residing within Delhi/NCR region. Willingness to travel on need basis from New Delhi work location.
